about_the_game:
Mamurius

Mamurius is a competitive tactical multiplayer shooter that combines intense action with strategic depth. Inspired by both hero shooters and tactical shooters, the game features 5v5 battles where team coordination, positioning, and individual skill are essential to achieve victory.

Players take control of advanced combat drones, each equipped with unique weapons and special abilities that define distinct roles and playstyles. Every choice impacts team balance and the outcome of the battle.

Tactical 5v5 Gameplay

Matches take place in online PvP battles with teams of five players, designed to promote tactical and competitive gameplay. Maps encourage area control, teamwork, and strategic use of abilities.

Each match requires communication, adaptability, and planning: winning is not only about eliminating enemies, but about reading the battlefield and making the best use of available resources.

Drones and Unique Abilities

Each drone represents a true “class” with specific characteristics. Some specialize in enemy detection, others in area control or direct damage. Special abilities allow players to:

  • gather tactical information

  • block or slow down opponents

  • deal targeted or area damage

Synergy between drones is essential to build an effective team.

Game Modes

Mamurius offers several modes to suit different types of players:

  • Training Mode, to learn the game mechanics

  • Unranked Matches, for casual and practice play

  • Ranked Mode, featuring a competitive ranking system and leaderboards

  • Story Mode (PvE), cooperative missions to explore the world and narrative of the game

Setting and Lore

Set in the near future, Mamurius originates as a global military project focused on the development of intelligent combat drones to face emerging threats. The name and concept are inspired by the historical figure Mamurius Veturius, reimagined in a modern and technological context.

Progression and Game Philosophy

Mamurius aims to deliver a fair and long-lasting competitive experience. The progression system allows players to unlock content permanently, without time-limited elements.

  • Competitive ranking system

  • In-game economy with internal currency

  • Permanently available content

  • No time-limited battle passes

The focus is on gameplay, player growth, and skill-based competition.

Key Features

  • Tactical 5v5 online multiplayer battles

  • Combat drones with distinct abilities and roles

  • Maps designed for strategic gameplay

  • PvP and PvE game modes

  • Competitive progression and rankings

  • Experience with no time-limited content
